notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes:
「kepler-2100」は9月25日10:00（UTC+8）にsteamプラットフォームで正式リリースされます！
ゲーム内容に関する指揮官の提案やフィードバックをよりよく聞くために、ゲーム中に指揮官が遭遇した問題を収集するための Q グループとカスタマー サービス アカウントを特別に設定しました。指揮官がゲーム中に問題に遭遇した場合は、タイムリーな連絡とフィードバックを得るために私たちに連絡してください。私たちはそれらを注意深く検討し、収集して要約し、対応する修理と調整を次々に行います。
サーバーオープンギフトパッケージ:
tm-KPL111
tm-KPL123
カスタマー サービス アカウントを追加し、グループに参加して特別な Steam イベントに参加し、追加のギフト パッケージを入手してください。
QQカスタマーサービス: 1595584560
QQグループ: 277032281

notes.title: 7.18 Update
notes.notes:
1. Appropriately reduce the difficulty of the new map mining point
2. Appropriately reduce the difficulty of the new map aircraft carrier BOSS
3. Significantly increase the rewards of the new map aircraft carrier BOSS
4. The refresh time of the new map aircraft carrier BOSS is adjusted to 12 hours and 24 hours
5. The large map marks the first star city (for players to check)
6. Arena and tournament can apply skill plans

notes.title: 7.11 Update
notes.notes:
1. Open a new map [Unknown Space]
(Open after conquering the level 4 star city at least once on the server)
2. Added 4 new mining points: "Aluminum Al", "Manganese Mn", "Chromium Cr" and "Titanium Ti"
3. Added aircraft carrier gameplay
4. Added interstellar aircraft carrier BOSS in Unknown Space
5. Added some general skills and exclusive skills
6. Arena and tournament skill plans are independent from personal plans
7. Added skill plan

notes.title: 6.21 Update
notes.notes:
1. New level cap for commanders
2. New distribution points for commanders
3. Added manufacturing function to avatar information
4. New [Dark Materials] output in Starry Sky Dark Domain
5. Decomposing equipment modules can obtain T3~T5 [Mechanical Core]
6. Added T6 equipment box (can only be obtained through manufacturing)
7. The minimum price of T3~T5 equipment in the market is adjusted to 60, 90, 120
8. Optimized the exchange content of the festival event store
9. Added new props rewards to the tournament ranking rewards
10. Added chronicle content
11. Fixed the bug of [Continuous Shooting] target offset

notes.title: 6.5 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added new weekly gameplay of Mechanical Storm
2. Fixed abnormal display of chat time

notes.title: 5.29 Update
notes.notes:
Adjustments to Positional Warfare:
1. All warship skill levels in positional warfare are synchronized to level 10
2. Positional warfare BUFF is refreshed 30 seconds after collection (old BUFF is removed)
3. Positional warfare BUFF refresh location is random
4. Positional warfare BUFF pickup time is adjusted to 15 seconds
5. Positional warfare map range is appropriately expanded
6. Attributes are increased by 5% for each death in positional warfare, up to 30%
7. Durability of positional warfare repair station is reduced by 50%
8. Positional warfare time is adjusted to 30 minutes

notes.title: 5.24 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added positional warfare gameplay (alternating with pirate invasion)
2. Added custom settings for automatic combat blood volume
3. Add chat time record

notes.title: Kepler-2100：Update
notes.notes:
1. Added resource mutual transfer function
2. A new 1,500 draw reward has been added to Chronicles

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.24 Update
notes.notes:
1. New weekly dungeon Scarlet Dark Domain (2 reward opportunities and 2 assistance opportunities per week)
2. Added new daily reset skill module for free
3. Mechanism adjustment: Control skills [glitch][load][overheating] cannot continue the number of rounds.
4. Mechanism adjustment: [Tactical Burst] cannot allow skills with a preparation round number of 1 to burst after [Superconducting]
5. Mechanism adjustment: Some skills have different effects in PVP and PVE.

notes.title: Kepler-2100: 4.23 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added 2 new daily tasks that are simple and easy to complete
2. Reduce some weekly task conditions
3. New force mission shortcut buttons are added in the big world, and the jump to mineral points is more accurate.
4. Simulated battles no longer require the fleet to be in the city
5. When dispatching a fleet, a fleet will be automatically selected
6. Added arena battle gameplay in the target shooting laboratory
7. Deadlock time adjustment: 5 seconds for the first period, 10 seconds for the second period, 15 seconds in total
8. Fixed the issue where pirates in force missions could not view details.
9. Optimize the display of mineral point map (highlighting the sphere of influence and displaying the main base)

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.19 Update
notes.notes:
1. Resource BUFF bonus props. Multiple uses can superimpose time.
2. A new random entry (attack speed) has been added to the "Engine" equipment
3. Optimize the task display. After completing the force task 300 times a week, the little red dot will no longer be displayed.
4. Optimize the Galaxy Overlord activity (after entering the scene, you will be invincible for the first 5 seconds)
5. The probability of dropping the starry sky dark domain technology solution is slightly increased.

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.18 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added Galaxy Overlord BOSS gameplay
2. New automatic battle in Starry Sky Dark Area
3. Added room password function in Starry Sky Dark Area

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.16 Patch Optimization
notes.notes:
1. Fix abnormal sound effect settings
2. Optimize single target skill damage coefficient
3. Optimize the purification mechanism: give priority to releasing control skills
4. Optimize the shooting splash mechanism: additional real damage can be triggered

notes.title: Kepler-2100: 4.12 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added new force mission gameplay
    (1) Added new gameplay of transporting goods
    (2) Added new method of destroying pirates
    (3) Added new task of capturing mineral points
          Force mission rewards include single mission rewards, weekly rewards, and level rewards
2. In the Starry Sky City battle, there is a new stage of destroying the Starry Sky City itself
3. Optimize the mode of warships attacking buildings -> change to laser spray

notes.title: Kepler-2100: 4.10 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Commander:
        In order to bring a better gaming experience, Kepler-2100 will open the second service area at 12:00 AM on April 10, 2024.

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.9 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added extreme level challenges in the target shooting laboratory
2. Optimize the animation of battle report details
3. Added 2x speed playback for battle report details
4. A more accurate description has been added to the battle report details.

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.7 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added commander's manual (novice mission)
2. Added alliance announcement function
3. Added battle details animation (trial version)
4.Fix the chat interface crash problem
5.Fix the chat garbled problem
6.Fix private chat translation problem
7. Fixed the first BUG that did not display when researching the data box

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.3 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added new vanguard supply email
2. New commander experience and gold coin rewards are added in the target shooting laboratory
(Commanders who have already been defeated will receive a difference compensation email)
3. Adjust the reward on the 7th day of the seven-day sign-in to T4 battleship
4. Adjust the order of unlocking some activities and functions

notes.title: Kepler-2100:4.1 Optimization patch
notes.notes:
1. The big world can be set to directly display the level of mineral points.
2. Based on player opinions, a new option has been added to skip all tutorials.
3. Optimize some game content and performance effects

notes.title: Kepler-2100:3.31 Optimization Patch
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where the enemy could not be destroyed occasionally triggered in the big world.
2. Optimize some interface lags
3. Optimize wheel and drag operations
